## Checklist

- [ ] Pinned dependency versions and a deterministic **fake model provider** are included.
- [ ] Tests cover the acceptance cases, policy boundaries, auth/validation, retailer
      isolation, ERP failure modes, and prompt-injection attempts.
- [ ] A single **evaluation command** runs and its **results** are included (with failures
      and classifier metrics), stating whether a real model was used.
- [ ] **Azure plan** + one architecture diagram + an illustrative config are included.
- [ ] **Design note** covers retrieval, policy enforcement, ERP reconciliation, auth,
      fallback, limitations, and the next improvement.
- [ ] **No credentials, real API keys, secrets, or personal data** are committed.
- [ ] Incomplete work is documented honestly.
